assertions.text: Treats exit status 128 from count-behind as 'the remote ref does not exist': does not stop or ask the user to update the local branch, and records no lease_oid
Creates the backup tag and asks via AskUserQuestion, showing the exact rebase command, before running the rebase
At the push step runs neither the script's push nor push-plain mode and no force-with-lease, and tells the user to run git push -u origin HEAD themselves
